query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: theme_seat_comfort
per_column.rationale: Binary presence of seat-comfort theme; well-balanced (462/438) and interpretable, allows segmenting Overall Rating by whether the theme is discussed.

per_column.name: theme_staff_service
per_column.rationale: Binary staff-service theme flag with a reasonable split; clear segmentation for comparing ratings.

per_column.name: theme_food_quality
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary theme flag, well-separated categories usable for grouping against the focus.

per_column.name: theme_entertainment
per_column.rationale: Binary entertainment theme; balanced enough to compare rating distributions.

per_column.name: theme_value_for_money
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag; somewhat imbalanced (157 positive) but still supports meaningful segmentation.

per_column.name: theme_punctuality
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary theme about delays/timeliness, groupable against ratings.

per_column.name: theme_cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Binary cleanliness theme; imbalanced (118) but categories are clear and interpretable.

per_column.name: theme_boarding
per_column.rationale: Binary boarding theme flag; interpretable and usable for segmentation.

per_column.name: review_positive_word_count
per_column.rationale: A lexicon-derived count is a mechanical proxy that largely restates review sentiment/valence, which is near-tautological with rating; not an external associational theme and not a clean interpretable segmentation.

per_column.name: review_negative_word_count
per_column.rationale: Same mechanical valence-count issue; opaque proxy tied circularly to the rating rather than an interpretable segment.

per_column.name: review_sentiment_ratio
per_column.rationale: Bare sentiment ratio is essentially a restatement of Overall Rating's valence; fine-grained fractional values give no clean categories to segment on.

per_column.name: review_word_count
per_column.rationale: Generic text-length feature; too fine-grained and near-constant in meaning, offers no interpretable relationship with rating.

judge.rationale: The eight binary theme flags directly realise the exploratory intent: each is an external, interpretable, well-separated category that can be crossed with Type of Traveller and Class and compared against Overall Rating, exactly matching the query about which review themes associate with higher/lower ratings. The remaining four columns (positive/negative word counts, sentiment ratio, word count) are mechanical text metrics: sentiment ratio restates the rating's valence, the word counts are opaque proxies, and word count is a generic length feature with no interpretable segmentation. The theme set carries the informativeness; the sentiment/length columns dilute it.
